_meta.use: Reference for Ari's Four Pillars competition drink (gin + char-grilled blood orange).

summary: Vivid sweet peel brightness over sugar, lemon and grapefruit; a raspberry note for bright sweetness, a hibiscus note for tart floral, plus rose and honey. Bridges: egg mirrors its mild creaminess; sweet vermouth's fig sweetness bridges its sweet-peel brightness.

example_recipe.name: Blood Orange Negroni (from Bottega, via Serious Eats)
ingredients: 1 oz freshly squeezed blood orange juice

competition_notes: Maps neatly to Cobber's live read: gin + blood orange is a proven bridge, and the harmonious notes (gentian, cinchona, vanillic, figgy, raisiny) point straight at amaro/Campari, tonic, vanilla and sweet vermouth — i.e. a Bloody-Shiraz-gin Negroni riff with a char-grilled blood orange oleo would sit right on these associations.
